note: Based on the species-level description of Trinervitermes sensarmai in Chhotani (1997), original in English; the soldier is dimorphic, with the major and minor forms combined in one paragraph; the alate is not described; the genus-level description that follows it in the same work is not included; synonymic citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head capsule golden brown; nasus reddish brown, slightly paler at the tip; antennae golden yellow; thorax, legs and abdomen yellowish brown; abdominal tergites dark brown. Head with microscopic hairs; body hairs sparse. Total body length 3.8–4.2 mm. Head capsule roundly pyriform; length excluding the nasus only slightly greater than the maximum width (length including nasus 1.78–2.00 mm, length to the base of the mandibles 1.10–1.20 mm, maximum width 1.06–1.15 mm); in profile the head is incurved behind the nasus and bears a small swelling. Nasus narrow and long, about two-thirds of the head length excluding the nasus (length 0.68–0.80 mm, ratio of nasus length to head length 0.62–0.69). Antennae 13-segmented; segments 2 and 4 subequal; segment 3 about twice as long as segment 2. Mandibles vestigial, without a spine-like process. Postmentum short and broad (length 0.22–0.32 mm, maximum width 0.30–0.38 mm). Pronotum small, saddle-shaped, the upper lobe short; anterior margin with a weak median incision (length 0.20–0.25 mm, width 0.50–0.60 mm). Legs long and robust. Minor soldier: head capsule dark golden yellow, paler posteriorly, reddish brown at the base of the nasus; nasus reddish brown, transparent at the tip; antennae and body cream-yellow. Head and body hairs sparse. Total body length 3.10–3.25 mm. Head capsule subrectangular-oval, slightly constricted behind the antennae (length including nasus 1.40 mm, length excluding nasus 0.77–0.80 mm, maximum width 0.55 mm); in profile the head is weakly incurved behind the nasus, the swelling slightly evident. Nasus long and narrow, about four-fifths of the head length excluding the nasus (length 0.63 mm, ratio of nasus length to head length to the base of the mandibles 0.78–0.80). Antennae 12–13-segmented; segments 2 and 4 subequal; segment 3 longer than segment 2 or segment 4. Pronotum small, saddle-shaped; anterior margin with a weak median incision, posterior margin nearly straight (length 0.18 mm, maximum width 0.38–0.40 mm). Legs long and slender.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule dark golden brown, pale yellow anteriorly; antennae and postclypeus pale golden yellow; thorax, legs and abdomen dark golden yellow. Head hairs sparse, body hairs moderate. Total body length 5.2–5.5 mm. Head capsule subcircular, slightly wider than long (length to the base of the mandibles 1.10–1.23 mm, maximum width 1.30–1.43 mm). Frontal plate translucent, oval. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 shortest, segments 4 and 5 subequal. Postclypeus convex, slightly less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped, with a large anterior lobe bearing a pale median incision (length 0.20–0.40 mm, width 0.60–0.68 mm); posterior margin without an incision.
